caption:
Your shop closes at 6pm.
The lead doesn't check your hours first.

Here's what an automated follow-up system does with an 11:47pm quote request while everyone's asleep.
Example workflow, not a client account.

11:47pm: lead fills out the form
11:48pm: a text fires with a confirmation and one qualifying question
11:52pm: reply saves straight to the CRM
7:40am: a morning text offers two appointment times
8:03am: the job is booked before anyone opens the inbox

Most shops let that same lead sit until someone remembers to call back.

DM TRIAL
#SpeedToLead #ServiceBusinessMarketing #LeadFollowUp #CRMAutomation #HomeServiceMarketing
rationale: Carousels/slideshows still lead 2026 saves and depth for B2B demonstration content, and this is the first after-hours lead walkthrough showing automated follow-up booking a job overnight, distinct from every prior capture, booking, reminder, dispatch, quote-stall, and no-show demonstration already shipped.
